title: Crimson Bridge [EP]
description: This is our self titled debut EP.

title: In Pitch Black
description: Our debut album 'IN PITCH BLACK', featuring the singles 'APOSTASY', 'TRAGEDY BEFALLS' and 'RUTHLESS TIDES (Feat. João Miguel)'
extra: Our hearts are filled with a sense of relief and accomplishment to finally be able to share the culmination of our collective sweat, blood and tears, with you all. We hope you play this loudly and on repeat, singing and playing along to each little detail, rhythm and melody. Enjoy it! <3
credits: Miguel Gao Nunes | Piano Arrangement on ‘Into The Unknown’
Tapebroz | Additional Arrangements & Piano Recording on ‘Into The Unknown’
João Miguel | Guest Guitars on ‘Ruthless Tides’
